canaryDiagnosis.primaryMechanism: The two writers that own these nine rails hardcode a Hays exclusion that has outlived its own stated condition. hauska-factory src/jobs/parcel-setback-cells.mjs:103 defines `IN_SCOPE_COUNTIES = ['48021','48055','48309','48453','48491']` with the comment 'P-145 gate: Hays (48209) receives no Phase 1/2 fill until identity reconciliation lands.' src/jobs/parcel-envelope-cells.mjs:100-101 imports the same constant verbatim ('HAYS (48209) STRUCTURALLY EXCLUDED, same as S1 (P-145 gate) -- inherited via IN_SCOPE_COUNTIES'). Together these two writers own exactly the nine rails named in the mission (setbackFrontFt/SideFt/RearFt/CornerFt/setbackRules from parcel-setback-cells.mjs; maxHeightFt/maxLotCoveragePct/maxFootprintSqFt/parcelAreaSqFt from parcel-envelope-cells.mjs). P-145 (OPS-16 plan of record, H1 Hays identity reconciliation) CLOSED 2026-09-13 (90_operations/OPS-16_texas_market_plan_of_record.md row A-136: 'H1 ... CLOSED', hauska-factory PR #142 mergeCommit 22bb0368). Git history on both writer files shows no commit since 2026-09-13 touching IN_SCOPE_COUNTIES (last touch 2026-09-12, PR #141, before the close): git log origin/main --since=2026-09-13 -- src/jobs/parcel-setback-cells.mjs src/jobs/parcel-envelope-cells.mjs returns empty. The writer's own gating condition resolved and nobody updated the code. Because these two jobs have literally never been invoked with county 48209 in scope, every in-city Hays parcel's cell for these nine rails still sits at the row-creation-time 'unaccounted' state. hauska-factory's evaluateRailGate (src/lib/parcel-record-engine/publish-gate.js:108-152, the P-195 fix) reads a populated-but-all-unaccounted (county,rail) as legitimately excludedDeclaredAhead ('indistinguishable from... a rail deliberately scoped to a subset of counties by design', its own module doc, lines 88-99) rather than RAIL_NEVER_FILLED (that code path only fires when cells.length===0, i.e. the county has zero parcel_record rows at all -- not Hays' case, since Hays rows exist and pass 31/65 other rails). That is the literal source of the 'excluded' verdict and the 'not-cut-over' refusal text the mission's canary observed.
canaryDiagnosis.secondMechanismConsideredAndRejected: Hays' membership in LDT joinNormalize.ts's LANDUSE_JOIN_DISABLED_FIPS_SEED / hauska-factory's SEED_BLOCKED_FIPS ({48209,48491}) -- the CAD-account identity join disable P-180 worked around for the dollar/structural rails. Rejected on two independent grounds: (1) the mission's own trap note is correct -- Williamson (48491) shares that exact seed and passes all nine rails live, so the seed cannot be the operative blocker; (2) at the code level, `git grep -n 'cad_property|prop_id' src/jobs/parcel-setback-cells.mjs src/jobs/parcel-envelope-cells.mjs` shows both writers key everything off txgio_parcel.prop_id as the place_key (`county_fips:prop_id`) and never reference cad_property, LANDUSE_JOIN_DISABLED_FIPS_SEED, or SEED_BLOCKED_FIPS at all -- their only inputs are txgio_parcel geometry, zoningDistrict (written by parcel-r5-zoning.mjs, which carries no Hays exclusion and is confirmed live-present for the probe parcel: brief.zoning.district='SF-6', disposition='present'), and the @empressaio/setback-corpus city tables. The CAD-identity damage OPS-21 Phase 2H describes (90_operations/OPS-21_serve_completion_program.md:183-199: dropped/drifted prop_ids, the StratMap graft, dollars joined on the wrong prop_id) is entirely about cad_property <-> txgio_parcel identity, a code path these two writers never execute. P-145's own program-doc text ('Lane H1 ... must land before Hays receives ANY Phase 1 or Phase 2 fill... the one place the program deliberately serialises rather than parallelises') is a blanket phase-boundary hold, not a per-rail technical dependency -- and it was applied to these writers via the same hardcoded list, so it is now stale exactly the same way for both, even though neither writer's data path was ever coupled to the CAD join the hold was protecting against.

If this falsifier fires anyway, the real blocker is something this diagnosis missed and must be named before any retry.
